text_to_image_prompt: Older adult man, neatly combed silver hair, narrow mature face and age lines, gray-green eyes, no glasses, black suit, gray waistcoat and tie, white shirt, black Oxford shoes, lean upper body and substantial natural legs. Single frontal eye-level head-and-shoulder portrait, neutral expression. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied approved casting sheet by extracting ONLY the specified actor into one standalone photorealistic head-and-upper-torso identity portrait. This is the EXACT SAME approved person, not recasting. Preserve their precise facial anatomy, eye shape/color, age, hairline, haircut/color, skin tone, characteristic features, clothing and accessories. Change only the pose/camera and background: strict front view, camera exactly at eye level, zero head yaw/pitch/roll, eyes level and directly facing the lens, head upright, shoulders level and square to camera. Neutral relaxed expression retaining natural character. Even soft frontal daylight, natural detailed skin, no beautification, no de-aging, no CGI. Flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background edge-to-edge, no gray, no beige, no gradient, no vignette, no shadows on the backdrop. Single person centered, whole hair/head visible with white margin above, upper torso to mid chest, portrait 3:4 composition. No hands, text, labels, borders, other faces or panels. Do not borrow any feature from any other person in the sheet. Target ONLY cell 06, BOTTOM ROW SECOND COLUMN: older lean man with neatly brushed-back SILVER hair, long narrow face, distinctive light eyes, clean-shaven face with realistic age lines, black jacket, gray waistcoat and gray tie. No glasses. Preserve his exact face, age and dignified calm. Do not make him younger, rounder-faced, or borrow features from the glasses-wearing man beside him.
reproduction_note: 独立提示词为成图重建描述；严格身份一致需同时参考已确认全身图与原始肖像。实际尺寸按PNG记录，不冒称2K或4K；背面细节为生成补全。
